content.short: Position Exchange is a decentralized trading platform with an on-chain order book.
content.description: Position Exchange is a decentralized trading and exchange platform delivering a transparent, trustless, and fully on-chain trading experience. At its core is an on-chain order book matching engine that gives traders full control over their orders while lowering transaction costs. Unlike automated market maker DEXs, it provides fully functional limit orders, bids, and offers. The platform also supports on-chain futures trading, derivatives, and staking pools. The POSI token strengthens the network, enables staking-driven passive income, and governs the protocol.
